public_boundary.note: Manifest exposes only public artifacts or aggregate status. Raw AIS/GFW, 0.01 degree working grids, vessel identifiers, tracks, and reconstructable source data must not be exposed.

front.caveat: Front object IDs are local-day identifiers.

sst.caveat: SST is environmental context and not a fishery outcome.

front_response.caveat: Current fixture validates the contract and UI path only; it is not real AIS/GFW evidence and is not catch, production, revenue, biomass, or guaranteed result.

front_intensity.reason: Front intensity archive has not been connected to the prototype pipeline.
front_intensity.caveat: Do not infer intensity values until a validated artifact exists.

fishing_effort_grid.reason: Map-facing fishing effort grid requires data authorization and public-display review before publication.
fishing_effort_grid.caveat: Do not publish raw or reconstructable GFW-derived data.
